Over half blame CCP for undermining cross-strait peace: MAC poll
summary: Taipei, Oct. 22 (CNA) More than half of respondents to a Mainland Affairs Council (MAC) survey believe the Chinese Communist Party (CCP) is undermining peace across the Taiwan Strait, an increase of nearly 5 percentage points from a similar poll in May, the agency said Thursday.

title: Cabinet approves tax incentives for TISAs
summary: Taipei, Oct. 22 (CNA) Taiwan's Cabinet, the Executive Yuan, on Thursday approved draft tax incentives for the Taiwan Individual Savings Account (TISA) program.

title: Avoid beaches, mountains during typhoon on long-weekend holiday: Premier
summary: Taipei, Oct. 22 (CNA) Premier Cho Jung-tai (卓榮泰) on Thursday urged the public to stay away from creeks, beaches and mountainous areas as Typhoon Champi approached Taiwan's main island, bringing heavy rain and strong winds over the Retrocession Day long weekend.

title: China's election interference in Taiwan becomes more targeted: NSB
summary: Taipei, Oct. 22 (CNA) China's election interference in Taiwan is now focusing more on specific groups and audiences, a senior National Security Bureau (NSB) official said Thursday.
